source_changes: LEON_SYSTEMD_RC=y explicitly selects Ubuntu helpers and LEON_SYSTEMD_RC=1 C profile. Original standalone role/signal semantics exist only in the separate compile-time profile; missing marker never selects them in the Ubuntu binary.
Manager HELLO/shim/authentication occurs before original /data/NVRAM/module effects. Stored process identity does not transfer to fork children. READY is emitted from the main dispatch loop.
Early SIGALRM joins blocked manager signals before sysinit handle_reap can raise it. Private /usr/libexec/asus/ash spawn clears child signal mask and restores parent mask.

rc-only linker wrappers cover kill/reboot/system from its own/retained static objects. Ordinary getpid and unrelated kill calls retain real semantics; no global syscall override or preload configuration.
Orderly gate before stop_services and shutdn. Ubuntu build excludes global kill(-1), raw final reboot loop and entire reboothalt delayed SysRq fallback. Broker/systemd owns power action.
AI service role checks ported; explicit AI-board reboot/upgrade GPIO/request actions remain separate and unchanged.

Separate0005 stops rc from starting/stopping Dropbear or touching its host keys/authorized_keys. start returns ENOTSUP and stop logs ignored ownership; OpenSSH ASUS policy translation remains a gate, not silently claimed implemented.
Separate0006 libovpn weak manager export returns client when missing; no runtime PID1 fallback in Ubuntu mode. UI callers and children cannot acquire manager authority.
